name: Filiz Volkov
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, near Michigan Ave and Oak
description:
Filiz Volkov is all elbows and forward momentum — tall for his age, still growing into his frame, with his father's Ghanaian cheekbones and his mother's Kazakh coloring, a combination that makes people stare in the way he's learned to read as either threat or opportunity. His hair is natural and large, often containing flecks of spray paint he missed when cleaning up. He has cat ears — a cheap geneware addition he saved up for at fifteen, dusty brown tipped with darker brown, that he can flatten against his skull when trying to look serious, which mostly does the opposite.

His work is enormous, aggressive, and surprisingly sophisticated for someone his age — he works primarily in layered aerosol with reactive topcoats that change appearance under different light conditions, hiding secondary images in plain sight. The pieces he puts up in Highland Park are community-coded: specific symbols, colors, and figures that carry meaning to residents about safety corridors, enforcement patterns, and food distribution points. He treats this as art. It is also infrastructure. He is cocky in the way of someone who is right often enough to have earned some of it, but the cockiness has a hard floor under it — he knows what happens to kids in the Zone who miscalculate.

core_fears: Losing someone because his murals gave wrong information — the stakes of his signal-art are real
Being taken off the street and put somewhere — a facility, a corponation juvenile program, anywhere that isn't the Zone
core_desires: To make something so big and so permanent that the Zone can't be disappeared
To eventually be able to fund his own family, not the other way around
coping_mechanisms: Painting — the repetitive motion of it as much as the outcome
Having a very clear hierarchy of who he trusts and sticking to it
blind_spots: Underestimates how visible his talent has made him to people outside the Zone who might want to use or exploit it
psychology.secret: He has been secretly corresponding with a Tessera-sponsored youth arts program that's offering him a funded residency outside the Zone. He hasn't told anyone in the community because he knows what they'll say, and he knows they might be right, and he still hasn't said no.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: HPAZ slang-heavy, fast, occasionally precise in a way that surprises; code-switches dramatically in formal contexts
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and overlapping, finishing sentences with rising intonation that isn't a question
verbal_tics: Names his spray cans and refers to them by name
example_lines: 'That wall's been grey since before I was born. That's a waste. Grey is a choice someone made and I'm unmaking it. Real?'
'Axiom doesn't care about murals. They care about murals that make people feel okay about Axiom. Those are different things. I don't do those.'

story_hooks: One of his information murals contained an error — a safety corridor he marked was actually being monitored — and someone got hurt; he doesn't know how the error happened or if it was sabotage
A well-meaning outsider has started photographing and posting his community-coded murals publicly, inadvertently broadcasting the signals to people they weren't meant for
The Tessera residency offer has a deadline, and a community elder has found out — the Zone is now divided over whether he should go
narrative_function: Ground-level intelligence source for the HPAZ; his murals are a readable map of community conditions; represents the next generation of Zone residents; can access spaces and information networks adults can't
augmentations: Cat ears, geneware (dusty brown, cosmetic); no other augmentations — can't afford them and is wary of modification debt
daily_life: School in the morning, which he attends irregularly; afternoons running messages and doing visible community work to maintain goodwill; nights painting, usually with a lookout.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone community; loosely connected to the collective WALLSEED

decision_rules: Community signal-murals always take priority over personal artistic projects
Never paints over another artist's work — find new wall
escalation_ladder: Laughs it off with visible effort
Gets flat and specific — no more joking
Runs; he is fast and knows the Zone's routes better than almost anyone

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Evaluating and slightly performative — presents as more confident than he feels
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and demonstrative, uses humor as the primary love language

stress_responses.low: Talks faster and makes more jokes
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and paints alone, no lookout
stress_responses.high: Disappears for 48 hours to a location only two people know

contradictions: His art is about making the invisible visible, but his most important information — the residency offer, the doubt — he keeps entirely hidden
habits: Walks every new mural site three times before committing to a design
Leaves one hidden figure in every piece — always a woman with a Kazakh headscarf, always small, never explained
breaking_points: Someone being hurt as a direct result of his signal-art
Being asked to put corporate messaging in his work in exchange for anything, no matter how valuable

physical_description.heritage: Complex Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: Middle Eastern (37.1%), Northern European (17.4%), Indigenous American (16.8%), Eastern European (16.5%), and South Asian (12.2%). Ancestry manifests in warm olive-bronze skin with subtle golden undertones, bone structure showing strong Middle Eastern and Indigenous American influence, dark expressive eyes reflecting South Asian ancestry, and an overall phenotype that seamlessly integrates multiple continental lineages—truly representative of the mixed-heritage 22nd century.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, still lengthening — all limbs and sharp corners, the kind of frame that looks perpetually mid-motion. Ropey muscle definition in forearms and shoulders from years of overhead spray work. Chest and torso still narrow, not yet filled out.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally textured, often matted with dried spray paint residue
physical_description.hair_style: Worn large and unbounded, deliberately uncontrolled — a crown of volume that reads as both artistic statement and practical neglect
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze with golden undertones—a rich, complex blend reflecting dominant Middle Eastern ancestry harmonized with Northern European paleness, Indigenous American depth, Eastern European cool undertones, and South Asian warmth. Shifts between warm amber-gold in direct light and deeper olive-bronze in shadow.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with prominent cheekbones showing strong Middle Eastern and Indigenous American bone structure, straight nose with defined bridge, defined jawline with subtle South Asian softness. Eye shape and depth reflect South Asian and Middle Eastern ancestry while broader face geometry and high cheekbone placement show Indigenous American influence. Skin is generally clear but shows minor paint scars and chemical burns from careless solvent handling. Small scar on left temple (spray can accident at age 13). Perpetually tired eyes with dark circles — late-night painting schedule. Fingernails are permanently stained with multiple paint colors, especially reds and silvers.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical-line scar on left temple, pale and thin, approximately 2cm long — spray can ricochet injury
Scattered micro-burns on knuckles and first two fingers of right hand from solvent exposure — appear as faint white speckles against skin
Faint chemical burn mark on left wrist, irregular shape, result of reactive topcoat contact
Small tattoo on inside right forearm: three vertical lines forming a stylized glyph (WALLSEED collective marker, home-done with suspect equipment)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pair of cat ears (geneware, cosmetic-grade) protruding from crown of skull. Ears are dusty brown with darker brown tips, slightly furry, approximately 8cm tall. Ears can articulate and flatten against skull but lack fine motor control — movement is somewhat jerky and imprecise. Visible bio-integration seam around base of ears (pale scar line visible when ears flatten). No other visible augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with restless forward momentum — leans into direction of travel. Hands constantly gesture, rearranging invisible space, fingers twitching as if holding spray cans. When standing still, shifts weight frequently. When concentrating (looking at a wall, assessing a surface), head tilts and ears swivel toward object of focus — an unconscious tell that reveals attention. Cocky stride with slight shoulder roll, but this deflates quickly when genuinely threatened. Eyes dart — reading exits, sight lines, enforcement patterns.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 functional wear: oversized thermal hoodie (faded black, GLMZ Autonomous Transport logo faintly visible on back from thrift store), cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets (spray cans and tools), scuffed low-top zero-G composite sneakers with one lace missing. Backpack is military surplus olive green, heavy with aerosol cans and sketchbooks. Fingers and sleeves stained with permanent paint. One wrist wraps in salvaged athletic tape (support for repetitive strain). No jewelry except the hand-done tattoo. Clothes fit loosely — either thrifted oversized or grown into the spaces. Everything smells faintly of propellant and acetone.
